theater: 裏海西岸巴爾達與鐵門關

battle.name: 羅斯人遠征裏海 (913年)
battle.theater: 裏海西岸巴爾達與鐵門關
battle.brief: 913年，羅斯大公伊果爾・奧爾戈維奇率兄弟沿伏爾加河順流而下、溯流入裏海，攻破阿蘭總督區首府巴爾達，掠走貨財；其後把艦隊拖向外海，遇上暴風，船舶盡毀，羅斯人僅伊果爾與少數親信得脫。卡面的秦弩是中國弩機，913年並不在羅斯人手中，而是裏海兩岸防軍的守城利器。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是羅斯公國（基輔羅斯）與哈剌子汗國（可薩汗國）在裏海西岸的一次直接衝突，時間是公元913年，起因是伏爾加河—裏海航路的控制權與其上的商利。羅斯一方由大公伊果爾・奧爾戈維奇與他的兄弟率領，編年史把兄弟合稱「伊果爾維奇」；隊伍自第聶伯河下游的羅斯營地出發，沿森林與草原的交界南行，經頓河流域進入哈剌子汗的勢力範圍，再乘船溯伏爾加河而下直抵裏海。遠征隊伍是典型的水陸合編：步兵與攻城者乘大型平底船（編年史所稱的「卡拉罕」大船），騎兵把坐騎趕上船同行，並攜帶弓、矛、斧與可作縱火之用的油脂。哈剌子汗一方是裏海西岸的行省體系：今日亞塞拜疆境內的巴爾達（Barda，阿蘭總督區首府）、達爾班特（Bab al-Abwab，鐵門關），以及亞速海北岸的薩爾克勒（別拉耶維日），由可汗派出的總督與城防軍把守，其船隊掌握伏爾加河出海口的航權，並有可沿伏爾加河追擊的弓騎。第三方是草原上的佩切涅格人與阿蘭人，以及十世紀初已介入伏爾加—裏海貿易的阿拉伯商旅；阿拉伯地理學家馬蘇第與伊本・魯斯塔的記述，是本役少數可與羅斯編年史互證的外部材料。
countriesEn: This war was a direct clash between the Rus' principality of Kiev and the Khazar Khaganate on the western shore of the Caspian Sea, fought in 913 CE over control of the Volga–Caspian water route and the trade that ran along it. The Rus' side was led by Grand Prince Igor Olgovich together with his brothers, whom the chronicle merges into a single designation, the Igorevichi. The column set out from the Rus' camps on the lower Dnieper, moved south along the borderland between forest and steppe, crossed the Don basin into Khazar territory and then travelled down the Volga by boat as far as the Caspian. The expedition was a typical combined river force: infantry and assault men rode in large flat-bottomed vessels, including the great ship the chronicle calls a karakhan; cavalry came along with their horses driven aboard; and the column carried bows, spears, axes and jars of oil usable for setting fires. The Khazar side was the provincial system of the Caspian's western shore: Barda in present-day Azerbaijan, seat of the Arran governorship; Derbent, the Iron Gates, known to the Arabs as Bab al-Abwab; and Sarkel, or Belaya Vezha, on the northern shore of the Sea of Azov. These were held by governors appointed by the khagan together with garrison troops, whose fleets controlled the mouth of the Volga and whose mounted archers could pursue raiders along the river. Third parties were the Pechenegs and the Alans of the steppe, and the Arab trading caravans already operating on the Volga–Caspian route in the early tenth century. The accounts of the Arab geographers al-Masudi and Ibn Rustah are among the very few external materials that can be cross-checked against the Rus' chronicle.
people: 核心人物是羅斯大公伊果爾・奧爾戈維奇，他與兄弟在九一零年代相繼取得羅斯諸城的統治權，一九一三年這場裏海遠征通常被視為他最冒進的一次行動；編年史把兄弟併入同一條記載，只以「伊果爾維奇」統稱這次出海。哈剌子汗方面，編年史提到鎮守裏海入口的哈剌子汗王子伊特拉克（Itlar），其城即後人常與巴爾達、達爾班特互指的裏海要塞；可汗一系當時還要應付宮廷內鬥與草原部族的挑戰。阿拉伯方面的關鍵記錄者是《往昔紀年》的編纂者，以及十世紀的地理學家伊本・魯斯塔，他寫下羅斯人沿伏爾加河直抵裏海、襲擊巴爾達的經過；九二二年出使伏爾加哈薩的阿拉伯使節伊本・法德蘭在《旅行記》中描述羅斯人的船隊、兵器與水葬禮俗，雖非本役目擊，卻提供了最接近的武器細節。944年重演同一路徑的羅斯遠征裡，瓦良格人首領阿斯科爾德與迪爾率眾來援，說明這場失敗最終把北歐戰士更深地拉進黑海世界。
peopleEn: The central figure is Grand Prince Igor Olgovich, who together with his brothers took control of the Rus' towns during the 910s; the Caspian expedition of 913 is generally treated as his most reckless undertaking. The chronicle folds the brothers into the same entry and refers to the expedition only as the Igorevichi. On the Khazar side the chronicle names the Khazar prince Itlar, who guarded the approaches to the Caspian from a town that later scholarship identifies with either Barda or Derbent; the khagan's own dynasty was at the same time occupied by court intrigue and by pressure from the steppe tribes. The key Arab witnesses are the compiler of the Primary Chronicle and the tenth-century geographer Ibn Rustah, who set down the account of the Rus' coming straight down the Volga to the Caspian and striking at Barda. The Arab envoy Ibn Fadlan, who reached the Volga Khazars in 922, described in his Risala the Rus' fleets, their weapons and their water burials; he was not an eyewitness of this campaign, yet his text is the closest detailed testimony on Rus' arms that survives. When the same route was run again in 944, the Varangian leaders Askold and Dir came with their followers, which shows how this defeat eventually pulled Norse warriors deeper into the Black Sea world.
kits: 卡面的秦弩是中國的弩機，戰國時代已定型：以木弩臂、機關與張弦器把拉力儲存起來，瞄準與擊發的精度遠勝拉弓，代價是射速低、上弦慢，一名弩手操作時旁邊還要有人替他重新上弦。公元913年，這件武器並不在羅斯人手上。《往昔紀年》與《諾夫哥羅德編年史》都沒有提到羅斯人使用弩；阿拉伯使節伊本・法德蘭九二二年在伏爾加河上描述羅斯人的兵器，列的是弓、矛、斧、劍與短刀，仍沒有弩的位置。真正在裏海兩岸流通的是弩的西方版本：中國弩技在八至十世紀已經沿中亞通道進入伊斯蘭世界，阿拉伯文獻稱之為「胡弩」；哈剌子汗國與阿拔斯王朝及巴格達保持密切往來，達爾班特與巴爾達的城防軍手上很可能就有這類弩機，用來在牆頭與船頭壓制登岸者。羅斯遠征隊真正倚重的投射兵器是草原式的複合弓，數量大、射速快、便於水陸兩用；近戰則靠斧、矛與帶鉤的登船器械，配合帶盾的射手與把馬匹趕上船的騎兵。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is the Qin-era crossbow mechanism, already fully developed by the Warring States: a wooden prod, a trigger housing and a cocking device store the draw weight so that aiming and release are far more accurate than with a bow, at the price of a low rate of fire and slow reloading, and a crossbowman needed a second man at hand to cock the piece again. In 913 CE that weapon was not in Rus' hands. Neither the Primary Chronicle nor the Novgorod First Chronicle mentions crossbows among the arms of the Rus', and when the Arab envoy Ibn Fadlan described the weapons of the Rus' on the Volga in 922 he listed bows, spears, axes, swords and short knives, with no crossbow among them. What actually circulated on the two shores of the Caspian was the western version of the weapon: Chinese crossbow technology had entered the Islamic world along the Central Asian routes by the eighth to tenth centuries, and the Arabic sources call it the hu nu, the Chinese crossbow. The Khazar Khaganate kept close contact with the Abbasid caliphate and with Baghdad, so it is likely that the garrisons of Derbent and Barda possessed such machines, used from the walls and from boat prows to hold back men coming ashore. The missile weapon the Rus' expedition actually relied on was the steppe composite bow, numerous, fast-firing and equally usable on water and on land; close fighting rested on axes, spears and boarding hooks with grappling irons, supported by shield-bearing archers and cavalry who drove their horses aboard.
tactics: 羅斯人這次的戰法完全依賴水路由下：以第聶伯河為基地，順流進入頓河與伏爾加河，靠自備或哈剌子汗協助取得的平底船隊構成一條流動的補給線；隊伍不帶攻城器，也沒有投石機，攻擊全靠人數與船。抵達裏海後，艦隊沿西岸南下，先攻下巴爾達這座阿蘭總督區首府，劫走城內貨物的記載之後，再向海峽方向推進，企圖越過達爾班特的關隘深入高加索。哈剌子汗方以岸防與海軍對抗：海峽關的城牆依山面海，牆頭射手與投射器居高臨下，狹窄水道令大船難以展開，而沿岸的哈剌子汗騎兵以弓騎不斷襲擾羅斯人的登岸小隊，迫使對方分兵。編年史記載，掠奪之後羅斯人把船隊拉出港口、駛向外海，結果遇上暴風，艦隊在開闊的裏海水面上失去抵抗能力。以水軍作為戰略核心，卻把兵員、馬匹與糧秣全部繫於船上的打法，是本役最致命的一環。
tacticsEn: The Rus' plan of campaign depended entirely on the water route: with the Dnieper as a base they ran down through the Don and the Volga, their flat-bottomed flotilla forming a mobile line of supply, whether the boats were their own or obtained with Khazar help. The column brought no siege engines and no stone-throwers; the assault depended on numbers and on the ships themselves. Reaching the Caspian, the flotilla moved south along the western shore and first fell on Barda, the seat of the Arran governorship; the chronicle records that goods were carried off from the town, after which the fleet pressed on toward the narrows in the hope of passing the Derbent defile and driving deep into the Caucasus. The Khazars answered with coastal defence and with their own fleet. The walls of the Caspian Gates stand mountain on one side and sea on the other, and the archers and missile engines on their ramparts fired down on anything in the water below, while the narrow channel denied the big ships room to manoeuvre. Horsemen of the Khazar host harried the Rus' landing parties from the coast with the bow, forcing the raiders to spread their force. The chronicle says that after the plunder the Rus' hauled their fleet out of the harbour and stood out to open water, where they met a storm and the flotilla lost all power of resistance on the open Caspian. Making the navy the strategic core while tying every man, horse and ration to the boats was the fatal flaw of the operation.
data: 能夠核實的數字不多，只能就範圍作出推算。羅斯遠征由第聶伯河下游到伏爾加河口再溯流入海，全程水路約一千五百至兩千公里；若由伏爾加三角洲橫渡到西岸巴爾達，海上航程還有四百至五百公里，且必須在裏海北段開闊水面行船，遇上逆風與湧浪的機會很高。編年史以拜占庭紀年六四二一年記此事，對應公元913年；一般推算遠征在春末至夏初出發，海上的損失則落在秋季風季前後。艦隊規模沒有留下可靠數目，只能從「卡拉罕」大船的存在，以及哈剌子汗需要從裏海各處調兵應急來看，判斷船隊與隨軍人數以數千計，並有大量馬匹、俘虜與貨物的搬運。地理上，巴爾達位在裏海岸線內側數十公里，是阿蘭地區的商埠；達爾班特的關隘是城牆與山海之間狹窄通道的組合，通道寬度不過數公里，卻卡住整條由裏海通向高加索山脈的陸路。隔了三十一年重演此役時，編年史記錄了羅斯人把馬匹趕上船並攜帶攻城塔與火攻器具圍城的細節，說明到944年他們已把攻城裝備補齊。
dataEn: Few numbers can be verified, so the estimates can only be given as ranges. From the lower Dnieper to the mouth of the Volga and upstream to the Caspian the Rus' covered roughly fifteen hundred to two thousand kilometres of water route; crossing from the Volga delta to Barda on the western shore added four hundred to five hundred kilometres of open sea, sailed on the exposed northern Caspian where headwinds and swells were likely. The chronicle dates the affair to Byzantine indiction 6421, that is, the year 913 CE. The expedition is generally assumed to have set out in late spring or early summer, with the loss at sea falling around the autumn storm season. No reliable figure survives for the size of the flotilla; from the existence of a great karakhan and from the fact that the Khazars had to draw troops from across the Caspian, the ships and their crews can only be put in the low thousands, with a great deal of horses, captives and goods to be moved as well. Geographically, Barda lay some tens of kilometres inland from the Caspian shore as the market of the Arran region, while the Derbent defile was a wall set across a gap of only a few kilometres between the mountains and the sea, and that gap commanded the whole land road from the Caspian into the Caucasus. When the same operation was run again thirty-one years later, the chronicle records that the Rus' drove horses aboard, brought up siege towers and fire-laying devices, and so by 944 they had equipped themselves for a siege properly.
cause: 為何會打起來，史料留下的線索有好幾條。第一是利益：巴爾達所在的阿蘭是裏海—伏爾加商路的西端門戶，絲綢、香料、魚獲、鹽與皮貨在此轉手，羅斯人南下就是衝著這條商路與其戰利品而來，編年史明確記載他們在巴爾達奪得的貨物與俘虜。第二是外交：哈剌子汗國在九世紀中葉以後曾向羅斯人徵收貢賦，羅斯人南下既是尋寶，也是要擺脫這層中間人的羈絆；913年的遠征可以看作羅斯人第一次繞開哈剌子汗的中介、直接打擊其南岸屬地。第三是草原政治的壓力，佩切涅格人與各部族不斷南下侵擾，羅斯公國需要在南方取得財源與盟軍；也有學者認為，羅斯人是受哈剌子汗內部一派僱傭，去攻打另一派的首領與其城邑，屬於草原慣用的傭兵式戰爭。第四是航路本身：編年史的作者把它寫成一場劫掠式的遠征，動機與後果都圍繞商路與控制權，沒有任何道義或復仇的理由。
causeEn: Several threads in the sources explain why this came to blows. The first is profit: Arran, with Barda in it, was the western gateway of the Caspian–Volga trade route, where silk, spices, fish, salt and hides changed hands, and the Rus' came south for that trade and its plunder, the chronicle explicitly recording the goods and captives they took in Barda. The second is diplomatic. The Khazar Khaganate had exacted tribute from the Rus' since the mid-ninth century, and the southern move was both a search for booty and an attempt to shake off that layer of intermediacy; the expedition of 913 can be read as the first time the Rus' bypassed the Khazar broker and struck the southern dependencies directly. The third is the pressure of steppe politics: Pechenegs and other tribes kept pushing south, and the Rus' principality needed money and allies from that quarter. Some scholars argue instead that the Rus' were hired by one Khazar faction to attack the prince and cities of a rival, the usual mercenary pattern of the steppe. The fourth is the route itself: the chronicler presents the expedition as a raid, with motive and consequence alike bound up with the trade route and control of it, and with no argument of right or revenge anywhere in it.
impact: 這次遠征的直接後果是慘重失敗：艦隊在裏海被風暴摧毀，羅斯遠征隊幾乎全滅，能回到本土的只有伊果爾與極少數隨從。編年史把它寫成對羅斯國家的一次重創，隨後幾年羅斯的內訌與對草原的失利，尤其是944年瓦良格人被佩切涅格人伏擊、羅斯人再度失手，都加深了危機，並促成羅斯人向君士坦丁堡求援，最終引來瓦良格人阿斯科爾德與迪爾，把北歐人的武器、航海與結盟經驗帶入東歐。從更長的視角看，913與944兩次裏海遠征打開了羅斯人通往裏海與高加索的航路：十一至十二世紀的羅斯商船沿伏爾加河與裏海深入伊朗與哈瓦利沙，帶回絲綢、香料、銀與魚，也把東歐的皮貨、蜜與奴隸運到南方。巴爾達雖遭劫掠，仍是裏海沿岸的重要商埠；哈剌子汗國的南岸航運因羅斯人的出現而收緊防禦，達爾班特的城防與火油儲備在往後的世紀裡持續擴建。阿拉伯方面的直接影響則是使節與商旅再次確認伏爾加下游的門戶對哈里發的絲路有利，九二二年伊本・法德蘭的出使正是這種背景下成行。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of the expedition was a catastrophic defeat: the flotilla was destroyed by a storm in the Caspian and the Rus' force was virtually annihilated, only Igor and a handful of followers making it back to the homeland. The chronicle treats it as a blow to the Rus' state, and the internal strife of the following years, together with the Rus' failures against the steppe, in particular the ambush of the Varangians by the Pechenegs in 944, deepened the crisis and pushed the Rus' to seek help from Constantinople. That eventually brought in the Varangians Askold and Dir, carrying Norse arms, seamanship and alliance-making into eastern Europe. Seen from further back, the expeditions of 913 and 944 opened a lane from the Rus' world to the Caspian and the Caucasus: in the eleventh and twelfth centuries Rus' merchant craft worked down the Volga and across the Caspian into Iran and Khwarezm, carrying back silk, spices, silver and fish, while moving hides, honey and slaves the other way. Barda, though plundered, remained a major emporium on the Caspian shore; the appearance of the Rus' tightened Khazar coastal defence, and the fortifications of Derbent and its stocks of fire oil were expanded through the following centuries. The direct effect on the Arab side was that envoys and merchants again confirmed the value of the lower Volga gateway to the caliphate's silk road, which is the background in which Ibn Fadlan's embassy of 922 was raised.
result: 打完之後，羅斯人只在裏海西岸取得一座被劫掠過的空城，沒有佔領任何領土：巴爾達的守軍退入內城與高地，達爾班特的關隘始終沒有被突破，羅斯人既沒有能力也沒有辦法在裏海西岸建立據點。最致命的一擊來自天氣，編年史把艦隊的覆滅歸於海上暴風，寫羅斯人把船拖到外海時遇上風浪，船舶在裏海北部的開闊水面上散架，伊果爾帶著親信逃回，其餘的人則溺死在海中。這場敗仗直接改變了羅斯人的下一步：隔了三十一年的一九四四年，羅斯人集結更多船隻並且僱請瓦良格人與佩切涅格人，重走同一條伏爾加—裏海路線，結果同樣因風浪與伏擊而失敗，並把瓦良格人更深地拉進東歐政治。從戰役層面看，本役以羅斯人攻下巴爾達、劫得貨財而開始，以全軍覆沒、目的未達而結束；從技術層面看，它證明了在沒有弩機、沒有攻城塔、沒有可靠糧秣的狀態下，羅斯的水軍可以順流一千多公里，卻無法控制一片陌生而多變的海面。
resultEn: When it was over the Rus' held nothing but a plundered and emptied town on the western Caspian shore and had occupied no territory at all. The defenders of Barda withdrew into the inner town and the highlands, the Derbent defile was never forced, and the Rus' had neither the means nor the intention to establish a foothold on the Caspian's western shore. The fatal blow came from the weather. The chronicle attributes the destruction of the fleet to a storm at sea: the Rus' hauled their ships out into the open, wind and wave met them on the broad water of the northern Caspian, the hulls came apart, Igor escaped with his closest men, and the rest drowned. The defeat directly changed what the Rus' did next. In 944, thirty-one years later, they mustered more boats, hired Varangians and Pechenegs, and ran the same Volga–Caspian route again, failing once more to wind and ambush and dragging the Varangians still deeper into eastern European politics. At the level of the battle, the campaign began with the Rus' storming Barda and carrying off goods, and ended with the whole force destroyed and its objective unreached. At the level of technique, it demonstrated that without crossbows, without siege towers and without reliable supply, the Rus' navy could run a thousand kilometres downriver yet could not master an unfamiliar and fickle sea.
